scripts.db: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec -T db sh -c 'until pg_isready -U qrreward -q; do sleep 1; done' && pnpm -C backend run db:deploy
scripts.dev: pnpm run db && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -C frontend exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: pnpm -C backend run test:unit && pnpm -C frontend run test:unit
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm run db
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run start:api" "pnpm run start:web"
